context_note: Comes from a single soybean season (2016), after 3 winters of cover crops (planted after the 2013, 2014 and 2015 harvests). One site with 4 reps (RCBD), no-till, fertilized to soil-test recommendations. The text gives no SE or p-value for the 15% figure; Fig. 1d shows SE. Earlier soybean (2014) and corn (2013, 2015) yields did not differ significantly ('data not shown'). This is the only effect size for the multispecies mix. The other covers (wheat, CR+HV, CR+CC) were numerically higher than control but not significantly, and their values are not in the text.

Absolute yield of the SHM treatment, not an effect size. The text does not give the control yield (Fig. 1d only). The extractor's ~3.96 Mg ha-1 control is back-calculated, not reported. It is redundant with E1 for effect-size purposes, so do not count it as a separate effect estimate.

Absolute soybean yield after cereal rye in 2016. The text says it was lower than the control but not significantly, and gives no control value (figure only). Use it as direction only (slight, non-significant decrease vs no-cover). The authors attribute it to reduced N supply.

issue: Corn yield outcome (the question's other crop) not captured as its own row; only mentioned in E1 note
